data.one_liner: Eliminates unnecessary characters from GraphQL queries to save bytes.
data.what_it_does: It removes whitespace and unnecessary characters from GraphQL queries. It integrates with GQL link serializers like HttpLink and DioLink to compress queries before requests are sent.
use_when: You want to reduce payload sizes for GraphQL requests
You are using GQL-based links such as HttpLink or DioLink
avoid_when: You are not using GraphQL in your application
Human-readable query logs on the network layer are strictly required for debugging
strengths: Reduces payload size for GraphQL requests
Easy integration with existing GQL request serializers
weaknesses: Limited utility outside of GraphQL workflows
data.setup_notes: Replace the standard GQL RequestSerializer with RequestSerializerWithCompressor in your link configuration.
